value.performance_fee_trigger: 9% of the positive performance over the high water mark

extracted_from: Management fees and other administrative or operating costs 1.50% of the value of your investment per year. Performance fees...We charge 9% of the positive performance over the high water mark.
extraction_notes: TER calculado sumando management fee 1.50% + transaction costs 0.07% = 1.57%. Performance fee es 9% sobre rendimiento positivo por encima del high water mark. No se reportan separadamente fees de ManCo, depositario o administrador.
